answer.rationale: Primary contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line sits at 94% and no buffer, so continuity cannot be gambled. Incumbent renewal has kept integration and deliveries stable (c1). Renegotiation at renewal previously recovered margin via market benchmarks (c4), and multi-year volume terms cut unit cost without narrowing scope (c6)—the path most likely to chase the 18% spend cut without adding delivery risk. Deferral (c5) applied to a non-critical month-to-month case and does not fit this expiry. Switch or second-source would be a second-cycle option; onboarding or split allocation now would raise interruption risk. Uncertain whether one negotiation can fully deliver 18%.
